race.title: Coral Long Distance Hurdle (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: The unbeaten LE FRIMEUR produced a taking display when scoring in Grade 1 company at the Punchestown festival and he might be able to improve beyond some of the more established names in this division, chiefly last season's winner Impose Toi , who also merits consideration given his exemplary record fresh. Ma Shantou is better than he showed at the Cheltenham Festival and would also be foolish to dismiss. LE FRIMEUR (FR) IMPOSE TOI (FR) MA SHANTOU (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Le Frimeur (3/1), Strong Leader (7/2), Ma Shantou (5/1), Soldier Reeves (5/1), Impose Toi (7/1), Wade Out (12/1), Caldwell Potter (12/1), Lavida Adiva (25/1), Lud'or (25/1), Supremely West (33/1), Thomas Mor (33/1)
